subject: RE: Renewal & expansion call — recap + next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@zenith.ai>, Pat O'Neill <pat.oneill@zenith.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-20T17:00:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Renewal & expansion call — recap + next steps

Hi Alex / Pat —

Thanks again for the productive conversation today. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we're all aligned.

Summary of current usage & health:
- Current monthly token spend: ~1.2B tokens (Prod gen + embeddings)
- Peak latency issues observed on longer multi-turn chats (95th p95 ~1.8s)
- Key workloads: customer support summarization, semantic search (embeddings), and batch content generation for marketing

Pain points & goals you reiterated:
- Need predictable cost and throughput as usage scales
- Reduce tail latency for multi-turn chat to improve CSAT
- Avoid model regressions during upgrades; want a simple rollback path

Proposed expansion path (high level):
1) Renew current contract for 12 months at committed capacity baseline
2) Add a Dedicated pool for peak traffic (burstable) to guarantee tail latency SLO
3) Add embeddings batch pipeline on optimized quantized instance to reduce token unit cost
4) Optional Private deployment for regulated workloads later this year (Q3)

Timeline & milestones:
- By Mar 10: procurement approval from Zenith (you)
- By Mar 17: Redwood sends SOW + pricing and draft contract
- By Mar 31: target signed SOW and start of Dedicated provisioning (staged rollout)

Open items / asks:
- Alex: confirm procurement contact + whether finance needs a PO on execution
- Pat: confirm whether the Private deployment (on-prem option) should be included in SOW as an add-on or a separate line item
- Redwood (Marissa): I'll attach a usage export and a preliminary SOW draft for your review; will follow up with a pricing worksheet and an estimate for Dedicated capacity cost delta

Attachments: usage_report_Q1.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB), preliminary_sow_draft.pdf (DOCX)

Thanks — happy to jump back on a quick call if you want to walk the SOW together.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1-415-555-0192

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@zenith.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Pat O'Neill <pat.oneill@zenith.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-20T18:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RE: Renewal & expansion call — recap + next steps

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and reflects what we discussed.

Quick notes:
- Procurement contact is Claire Huang (claire.huang@zenith.ai) — she's looped below.
- Targeting internal approval by Mar 10; we may need a one-page business justification for finance.
- Please include a line item for Private deployment as an optional add-on.

On the latency piece: could you include expected 95th percentile latency estimates for the Dedicated pool vs current hosted? That will help the CS and infra teams sign off.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

-- 
Alex
Head of Platform, Zenith AI

From: Pat O'Neill <pat.oneill@zenith.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@zenith.ai>

Date: 2027-02-20T19:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RE: Renewal & expansion call — recap + next steps

Thanks Marissa.
Please also add an estimate for storage and retention costs tied to embeddings (we have growing vectors backlog). If you can call out any discounts at committed volume tiers that'd be helpful.

Pat
VP, Data Science

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-21T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: RE: Renewal & expansion call — recap + next steps

Looping you in for pricing & SOW prep. Key asks from Zenith:
- 95th percentile latency estimates for Dedicated pool vs hosted (include p50/p90/p95)
- Pricing worksheet with committed tiers + burst pricing; show delta for embeddings optimized quantized instance
- Optional line for Private/on-prem deployment (separate add-on)

Can you:
- Sean: put together latency estimates + recommended Dedicated sizing by Mar 3
- Marcus: draft pricing worksheet and recommended discounts for 12-month commit by Mar 4

I'll prepare the SOW skeleton and one-pager for finance. Zenith procurement contact: claire.huang@zenith.ai

Attachments: signed_sow_v2.pdf (once we have it we'll reattach)

Thanks,
Marissa
